messages:
sofia: Heads-up: ran a focused microbench for ceres-7b on our summarization slices comparing fp16, int8, int4. Results below. Not recommending int4 for now due to noisy ROUGE drop on abstractive prompts.

daan: paste the numbers

sofia: table:
```
slice      | cfg   | p50 | p95 | $/1M | rouge-l
summary    | fp16  | 130 | 490 | $10.2 | baseline
summary    | int8  | 118 | 420 | $6.8  | -0.9
summary    | int4  | 150 | 760 | $4.1  | -3.7
```

product-lead: can we do hybrid? maybe int8 for most, int4 for chat?

sofia: yes. proposal: chat->int4, long-summ->int8, critical->fp16. Canary config + sentinel suggested.

ops-bot: Canary started: ceres-7b-int4, traffic=3%

sofia: follow-ups: run longform sentinel daily, add a human review sample of 200 items/day for first week.

product-lead: ok please publish the brief and ROI note.

sofia: will do. published brief link: https://docs.redwood/gtn/ceres-7b-brief

ops-bot: Canary update (24h): hallucination +0.4% (below threshold), rouge delta -0.3% (within), latency p95 +5%

sofia: thanks all. will re-open if we see >1% rouge drift.
